pieces.pieceName: Rust or brown pointed scarecrow hat
pieces.styleNotes: A floppy pointed hat anchors the scarecrow. Choose warm rust or brown; none reproduces every patch, rope and sunflower in the generated image. The separate patch fabric can personalize an undecorated hat.

options.title: Scarecrow Hat
options.notes: Tan pointed costume hat with wide ragged brim, dark stitching and straw-textured trim. Paler than rust. Hat only; the model photo also shows a wig and neck trim, which are not described as included. Merchant calls the hat straw; its fiber is not specified. Live feed confirms the single variant available at $14.99. Ships Monday–Friday from Chicago; no arrival promise.

options.title: Scary Cute Scarecrow Hat - Crow - Straw Trim - Costume Accessory - One Size
options.notes: Faux suede hat includes tall peak, jagged brim, patches, rope band and attached small black crow. About 25-inch circumference; fits most teens and adults per merchant. Brown rather than the image's orange rust; crow replaces its sunflower. Live feed confirms available at $19.99.

options.title: La Sorciere Witch Hat in Rust
options.notes: Rust-colored pointed witch hat with a black band and edging provides the warm color. Its compact brim differs from the illustrated floppy brim. Patchwork, rope, straw and sunflower are not included. Merchant does not state fiber, dimensions or a size range. Primary HTML marks InStock and quantity 1 at $229 USD. US shipping is offered. More expensive does not mean a closer finished scarecrow match.

gaps: Rust hat alternatives differ in shape and decoration. The premium hat has no published sizing; confirm fit before purchase.

pieces.styleNotes: Real cotton fabric supplies replace loose straw at wrists and ankles. Cut narrow strips with scissors, leave a solid band at one edge, and tack the band inside each cuff. These are DIY materials, not finished cuffs.

options.title: Cotton Muslin - Natural
options.notes: Natural 100% cotton muslin, 44 inches wide. The actual purchasable unit is 0.25 yard at $2.50; the storefront displays $10 per full yard. Live HTML quantity selector defaults to 0.25 yard and feed confirms available. One unit is about 9 × 44 inches: measure wrist and ankle bands before cutting and order more quarter-yard units if needed. This cream fabric must be cut and sewn into fringe; scissors, thread and completed cuffs are not included.

options.title: UNBLEACHED COTTON MUSLIN 47" | SH001
options.notes: One continuous yard of 47-inch-wide, 100 GSM, 100% unbleached cotton muslin at $4.99. Natural ecru is paler than straw. Prewash before cutting; merchant warns of 3–5% first-wash shrinkage. Cut narrow strips and stitch into wrist and ankle bands. Feed confirms Natural Unbleached available. Ships from the US; no exact dispatch date stated.

options.title: Kona Cotton – Straw
options.notes: Price is one full yard at $10 per yard. 44-inch-wide, 100% cotton in Straw, 4.35 oz / 147.5 GSM. The warm tan color is closer to the illustrated straw than undyed muslin. Primary page shows 12 yards in stock and InStock structured data. Fabric must be cut into strips and attached to cuffs; it is not raffia or ready-made fringe. No dispatch promise stated.
